jobs.name: StylePulsar
jobs.prompt:
Use case: background-extraction / precise-object-edit. Production transparent sprite atlas for Cubrism. Reference is the APPROVED full equipment grid. Extract and faithfully reproduce ONLY the FIVE Pulsar icons: compact single-barrel blaster in FIRST row, same green/white body panels, pistol grip, trigger guard, circular side energy cell, short round barrel. Do not redesign. Match the reference's exact silhouette, illustration style, material ratios, details, perspective and per-color arrangement. Remove the catalog background, labels, table lines and all other families completely.

Output a single transparent landscape atlas, EXACT 3 columns by 2 rows of equal cells, canvas aspect ratio 3:2 (ideally 1536x1024). Cell order: top-left WHITE, top-middle GREEN, top-right BLUE, bottom-left PURPLE, bottom-middle ORANGE. Bottom-right completely EMPTY transparent. Five icons, no sixth duplicate. Each icon centered in its cell, fitting within central 80 percent width and height with clean transparent margins. Identical scale and geometry in all five cells. No text, badges, tile frames or ground shadows. True transparent alpha outside each object, including inner open gaps such as trigger guards. Do not draw a checkerboard. Preserve opaque dark glass on the power core and opaque internal mechanical cavities.

White: white enamel panels, neutral white light and silver shading, ivory structural accents; no green or other color glow. Green/blue/purple/orange variants: vivid corresponding enamel colors and matching energy effects, with ivory structural trim and charcoal joints. ORANGE is orange, not gold/yellow panels. No green leakage in blue/purple/orange variants. Bright colored surfaces dominate over ivory/grey, exactly as the approved reference. Crisp edges, enough simple detail to read as a small inventory icon. No extra objects or ornaments.
